l1_words.meaning: to carry out, put into practice

pattern_explanation: Planet and orbit come from the same Greek and Latin roots in both languages, so their forms stayed close. The word for relevant has a similar shape to the English word actual, but the two have different meanings.
false_friend_warning: The Ukrainian word transliterated as aktualnyi looks like the English word actual, but it means relevant or up to date. English actual means real or existing, so students should not translate aktualnyi as actual.
